## Plan

Simulate from a skewed population, draw samples of decreasing size, and record
the empirical coverage of the bootstrap percentile interval at each size. The
claim to test is that coverage degrades gradually rather than falling off a
cliff, and that the degradation is asymmetric for skewed data.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
n_grid <- c(5, 8, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50, 100)
# ... coverage simulation to follow
```
